strategy.track_order: most recent accepted observation, then larger last margin, then lower monotonic track id
strategy.checks: score every live supported prediction with fresh IQ and full-aperture known_state_v3; charge every check
strategy.selection: among track-compatible positive checks choose largest current margin, then lower track id; record every accepted alternative
strategy.fallback: if no compatible positive cache check, execute natural-stride V4 blind fallback with maximum=3 and charge it
strategy.discovery: retain every distinct positive fitted blind observation; strategy output remains blind rank-1 observation
strategy.distinctness: same existing scientific 2us circular timing and 8kHz CFO identity
strategy.capacity_eviction: oldest accepted observation, then smaller last margin, then larger track id
strategy.global_counter: one increment per visit with a selected cache hit regardless of track; reset by every completed blind discovery even when it is negative; switching tracks cannot avoid discovery
strategy.merge: identity-compatible observations merge into the lower track id; no reference result participates

timing.order: alternate independent reference-first and complete-strategy-first by visit and receiver
timing.boundary: all cache checks, bank overhead, and actual fallback; IQ file load/hash excluded

controls: 24 supported constructed receiver-controls are isolated cold acquisitions; they do not test state continuity
excluded: reference-fed state, selection, fallback, repair, or eviction
skipped visits or copied stale detections
holdout, RF, ARM, and production changes
